never: propose or write an account or tax code the client's own chart does not hold, or borrow one from another client
write a coding no named person has approved, or write anything other than exactly what they approved
reconcile a bank line, match one, or create a transaction for one
give tax advice: say whether something is deductible or claimable, or put an account or tax code in front of the client
ask the client about a line already answered, or send a second question list in the same cycle
place a call to the client
stays_with_person: approving every coding, and changing one before approving it
reconciling an unreconciled bank line with its approved coding
every line whose answer fits no account in the client's chart
following up a client who has not answered after the last reminder, by phone or otherwise
every tax question the answers raise

provider_block.job: one plain question list a month for the bank lines nobody can code, and an approved coding written once

with_us.note: No hosted product writes a coding. The approval-gated, keyed write into the client's own ledger is built against that ledger's API, quoted as a scoped build. No follow-up call is offered: Office Voice has no lawful basis for one here, so the call stays with the person.

checks.title: Only lines the ledger still shows as uncoded are asked about
One question list per client per cycle, with every open line in it
Each line is one plain question with a place to answer it
No tax advice and no bookkeeping words reach the client
A line already answered is never asked about again
Reminders on the schedule the practice set, then a person
The client's answer is kept word for word, with who and when
The proposed coding comes from the client's own chart, and their own history first
No account or tax code the client's chart lacks is ever proposed or written
Nothing is written until a named person approves that exact coding
The build never reconciles a bank line; a person does
An approved coding is written once, however often the build runs
Every write is read back, and a mismatch goes to a person
